snippet.textDisplay: No ability to create explosive plays, constant 3rd and longs, and momentum killing bad calls/no calls was UKs downfall in this one. People can't stand the ref talk but I think the 2 bad holds and that missed PI call in the endzone defined KYs first half. At the half KY had more yards total than TN, 231 to 162, with 13 first downs to their 4. 13! They just couldn't score or keep drives alive all the way to the redzone. In the 2nd half KYs offense slowed and then stalled out, putting up 137 yards to UTs 227, and didn't even score a TD. The game was pretty much over at the end of the 3rd, and ended on that failed 4th down conversion. Pathetic deer-in-the-headlights playstyle from Kentucky, and some good-ole Neyland homecooking, make it another KY classic in the long list of losses to UT.
